headings: From first conversation to funded deal
Access to the full lending market
cedarcommercial.ca.body_sample: Skip to content | Cedar Commercial | Talk to Us | British Columbia · Alberta · Ontario | We arrange commercial mortgages across British Columbia, Alberta, and Ontario for purchases, refinances, construction, and private deals. Our team structures each transaction to fit your goals, then sources capital from banks, credit unions, CMHC programs, and private lenders so you can compare options and move forward with confidence. | Talk to Us | 38 years | Combined experience in commercial real estate | $1B+ | Funded and underwritten across our brokering careers | 500+ | Commercial files funded across purchases, refinances, and construction | 100+ | Lenders we work with: Schedule I, II, and III banks, credit unions, and private capital | About Us | Commercial lending still runs on experience and relationships. Underwriters are busy, so they prioritize the deals they think are worth their time, and appetite shifts with the market and with what is already on their books. A good offer comes down to knowing which bank is interested in your type of property this month, and having a professional relationship with people who set the terms. The rest is packaging the file so they are not digging for the numbers they need. Thirty-eight years between us, and we teach the course other brokers take to learn this work. | President, Commercial & Residential Financing | Two decades in commercial real estate, with earlier roles as a real estate appraiser, commercial banker, and private banker. Tuan works on complex credit requests and has arranged land and construction financing for developers and investors since 2017. | DLC Masters Award, top 1% of brokers | Vice President, Commercial & Residential Financing | Eighteen years across real estate and investment, including residential and commercial underwriting and a term as senior financial analyst at one of Canada's top-performing REITs.
